Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de utilaje industriale
As a software engineer, you develop and maintain state-of the art application software for challenging high-tech projects.
This role is focused on Python development within the Diagnostics team, where you’ll collect, process, and visualize machine data. You’ll work day-to-day with Python, C++, Linux, Git and CI/CD pipelines, building applications that help monitor machine performance, support customer service teams and continuously improve the machine software platform.
What excites you as a Software Engineer?
From our Cluj-Napoca office, in Romania’s tech-driven second city, you join a vibrant IT scene. The city blends startups, global firms, and top universities. You will fit in our team if you like to:
Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications and components using Python and/or C++.
Translate system and business requirements into technical solutions.
Participate in software architecture and design discussions.
Ensure software quality through code reviews, unit testing, integration testing, and continuous integration practices.
Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects and performance issues.
Support software integration, qualification, and release activities.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across software, customer service, and integration domains.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of software development methodologies, tools, and processes.
 Sounds good so far? We'd love to tell you more…
This is what you bring to the table
Minimum 5 years of professional experience in Python software development.
Good understanding of object-oriented programming principles and software design patterns.
Experience working in Linux-based development environments.
Experience with Git version control.
Knowledge of software development lifecycle and CI/CD practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to understand and work within complex technical systems.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work effectively in cross-functional Agile teams.
 This is what you can expect in return
You will work with passionate colleagues who share your drive for technology and business success.
You get a lot of freedom and responsibility; after all, you know exactly what you are doing.
A welcoming environment with opportunities for personal development and professional growth.
You'll work in a prime location with easy access to public transport and nearby amenities. The office’s innovative design and focus on well-being create a space where creativity and projects thrive.
Flexible 40 hour working week, with room to work from home.
We also find it important to have fun together. We organize a lot for our employees, from
Christmas parties with Santa and families and rooftop parties, to inspiring knowledge sessions for the high-tech community.
Fun team-building activities.
 High Tech & High Fun
